profile.name: Mehdi Teymorian
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer · Backend & Distributed Systems
profile.tagline: An engineer who reads the terrain — of systems, and of mountains.

prose: I build backend systems in Go — event pipelines, distributed services, and the brokers and data stores underneath them. I care most about data correctness and systems that stay calm when everything is on fire. I mentor engineers across teams and carry the pager for what we ship.
about.personal: Off the clock I'm usually moving — running, a trail, a camera — carrying the same love of math and old questions up the mountain.
